import json
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd


def fit_wealth_quantile(df: pd.DataFrame, q: float, year: int = 1996) -> dict:
    """Linear quantile regression of composite_wealth_<year> on race, sex and
    ever_jailed at quantile q.

    Returns {"coef": {"intercept", "black", "hispanic", "male", "ever_jailed"}, "n"}.
    """
    raise NotImplementedError


def main() -> None:
    data = Path(__file__).parent / "data" / "nls_incarceration_processed.csv"
    df = pd.read_csv(data)
    print(json.dumps({str(q): fit_wealth_quantile(df, q) for q in (0.1, 0.5, 0.9)}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

item.text: The implementation now uses a sparse equality-constrained LP and scales the dollar outcome for numerical stability. One supplied assertion conflicts with the stated loss definition: its requested 90th-percentile incarceration coefficient has a strictly higher check loss than the LP minimizer.
